detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=gcp`.
• Install and configure Cloud posture integration via provider TA with the modular input for `azure:monitor:activity`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.10.1.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `operationName` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=gcp sourcetype=azure:monitor:activity.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="azure:monitor:activity" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="azure:monitor:activity" Title="*0.0.0.0*" OR Title="*Any*"
| table _time operationName caller resourceId resultType
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.10.13_gcp_cspm_overly_permissi_13"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `azure:monitor:activity` in `index=gcp` to detect gcp cspm overly permissive network path. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the Azure portal Activity Log blade for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `operationName` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_10_13_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Cloud posture integration via provider TA and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
